Sana - a superorganism inside which the story is set


Hell:

The Hell part of Sana has multiple levels 

Limbo - Limbo the first Level of Sana and start of your journey towards heaven though pits of Hell 
It's a world of endless grassy Planes toxic bright colors and Endless feeling of Liminal and nostalgic, on the level are a lot of grassy hills and wind turbines sticking out of place, the layer itself is endless , and it has no caves or holes in it naturally made

Flora and fauna of the level are grass that grows on the hills it bleeds when broken or cut, there are animals on the level
Dog like creatures without faces are rarely running around in small groups - 50 HP , faceless cats that hide between grass - 35 HP, faceless rabbits that are not edible because their meat rots when touched they dig holes in the ground that erupt blood - 20 HP 

By digging down you will find flesh and blood and remains of people and animals who stayed on the level when night started 

On the level you will find abandoned structures that looks terribly misplaced, Soviet era houses just standing in open fields for next kilometers 
Walls just randomly sticking from the ground 
Abandoned huts that can just float mid air 

Than more far away from starting point you go than more taller the grass will get until in 100 km it will get as tall as skyscrapers and it will look like hands
The temperature on the level is always 27° and and it's always sunny 

This level has sublevels 

The CITY sublevel - this sublevel can be entered by finding the tower of babel that will guarantee appear in 10 km from start in any direction by climbing the tower you will enter a city floating in the sky above clouds, the city is endless and it copies American suburbs from 1940s to present and descending into future as far away it gets from the starting point

The sublevel is inhabitated by humanoids without faces they look like average people with average lives just without faces, they have jobs, families, they watch moves, they enjoy internet, but without faces, they are not hostile towards travelers but they will attack if you hurt them, they will give you food and aid if you need it and they will provide you a house  - 200 HP 

The humanoids did domesticate the animals from the main level , now they roam on the streets often causing traffic jams 

The CITY is the only place in the entire Limbo where are trees and it's considered a safe heaven for traveler who got there, many travelers got there and many people stray there

The weather can change on this sublevel but seasons don't it's always mid summer 

The average temperature is 30-35° during day 
And 25-30 at night so everyone has a swimming pool often just placed on the street for everyone

To exit the sublevel you need to go the way you entered it

Another sublevel is the MINES sublevel it could be entered by digging way to much down 

The MINES is a sublevel that is fully made from German mines from around 1940s going endlessly down, the sublevel is known for bad air quality and high chance of poisoning by unknown gasses in it

On the sublevel can be found mining instruments from that time and remains of the previous travelers who got killed, the surfaces of the mines are ground that seems to be like cutted out from various places across the solar system making the tunnels be with completely different type of soil and rocks every 100 meters, the walls have lamps on them but there will be much less light further you go 

The darkness on the sublevel is deadly by staying in the dark for way too long you will be swallowed alive by walls and your body turned into ores 

The sublevel is inhabitated by Miners those are humanoids with large hands and 2 heads, they mine the ores from the mines and sent them on railways, they are not hostile at most of the times but if you disturb them way too much they will kill you, they can not speak and they don't need food or sleep  - 400 HP 

The fauna of the sublevel is unique it is bats without eyes size of baby bear, their wings look like skinless meat their mouth has 2 large teeth 
They are highly aggressive and can be found in their nests where they will protect their eggs with all costs, if you kill the bats and take the eggs you can cook the eggs for a large meal or take the eggs and wait for them to grow up to get a pet bat that will protect you but require daily food and belly rubs, they eat only meat and blood 
The worms that dig small tunnels in the mines they are not hostile and look like a gigantic rain worm after killing them you can eat their meat but it's very disgusting, adult bat - 250 HP, baby -50 HP 
Worms - 200 HP 

The rails are large tunnels with rails where all ores go, you can exit the sublevel by going straight on the rails for 2,5 km

The average temperature is ranging from 0° to 2354 depending on how deep you go

The finale sublevel is the NIGHT 
It's basically the same Limbo but with blood moon 

You can appear in the sublevel by dying in Limbo 

The fauna of the sublevel is deadly 
Electricity towers walking creating small earthquakes, they destroy everything around them by squishing them under their weight or by giving deadly amount of electricity from their cutted vires - 1.5k HP each

On the ground are swarming humanoids 
They are extremely tall and skinny with large jaws and black eye sockets, they rip apart everything that is not looking at them however they are slow and often attack each other  - 500 HP 

Like mountains gigantic tarantula like beasts 2 km in size Walk, on top of them the wind turbines that are actually it's ears, it's hair looks like forests it just exist without a reason or purpose  100k HP 

In the sky are eyes millions of eyes looking at everything daring to swallow whole the one to come near them - 200 HP 

The ground below is bleeding flesh the buildings are full of acids 

To exit the sublevel you need to die again
